mapper.select: SELECT sys28_login_real_time_id AS login_real_time_id , TO_CHAR(sys28_login_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_time_str , sys28_ip_address AS ip_address FROM sys28_login_real_time WHERE sys28_person_id = #{personId} AND sys28_login_time BETWEEN (f_sysdate() - interval '10 minute') AND (f_sysdate() + interval '10 minute')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys28_login_real_time SELECT f_create_seq() , #{personId} , f_sysdate() , #{ipAddress} , null
